name: reachinbox-email-scheduler-monorepo
description: Production-grade Full-Stack Email Job Scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Ethereal SMTP

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@reachinbox/shared && npm run build --workspace=@reachinbox/api && npm run build --workspace=@reachinbox/worker && npm run build --workspace=@reachinbox/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@reachinbox/shared && npm run build --workspace=@reachinbox/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
